title: Sessions: the eight re-export shims retired, one module set, the old card tree folder removed

chat.text: The module census found two Sessions module sets; the eight files under ai/sessions only re-export the live ones in ai/AISession. Their four importers are repointed, the shims move aside by script with an undo, the readme says where the classes live, and the empty old framework/ai/2026 folder goes for good.
